notice: Fictional products and orders only. No payments. Store emails disabled in demo mode.
intro: Sales, orders and stock. One clear view of your demo store.
revenueHelp: Processing + completed order totals. No refunds in demo dataset.
trendHelp: Synthetic daily order totals in USD, processing + completed.
searchOrders: Search fictional customer or order ID…
emptyHelp: Try a different search, date range or filter.
topHelp: Ranked by synthetic paid-order line sales.
noteHelp: Use fictional operational notes only. Nothing is emailed.
stockHelp: Whole units, from 0 to 9999. Conflicting edits are rejected.
settingsHelp: Display preferences for this plugin only. WooCommerce currency and checkout settings are unchanged.
thresholdHelp: Products at or below this quantity are flagged. Range: 0–100.
guardrails: Only plugin-tagged synthetic records can be changed here. No payment actions or outgoing notifications.
scope: Exports include all plugin-tagged demo records, not only filtered rows.
stockIntro: A small check now keeps the next order in view.
orderIntro: Review fictional orders, update supported statuses and keep internal notes.
inventoryIntro: Track synthetic stock and make guarded quantity edits.
analyticsIntro: Explore the demo dataset. These are not real business results.
activityIntro: An audit trail of changes made through Commerce Desk.
transitionHelp: Status changes affect the synthetic workflow only. Automatic stock changes, emails and payment actions are disabled.
notePlaceholder: e.g. Demo parcel prepared for dispatch
translations: French and German are machine-assisted and not professionally reviewed.
notAvailable: No paid-order sales in this period.
dateError: Choose a valid start date on or before the end date.
comparison: Effect: scattered views → one operations workspace
noSpeed: No speed or sales uplift has been measured.
baseline: Standard WooCommerce views remain available. This plugin adds a focused operations layer.
model: Original dashboard design, not a copy of a storefront.
stockTip: Replenishment is not automated. These flags are a demo aid.
emptyNotes: Add a fictional note to demonstrate the workflow.
